1. CHICKEN STEW WITH HERB DUMPLINGS
1 Chicken Stew with Herb Dumplings
Mollis vel, tempus placerat, vestibulum condimentum, ligula. Nunc lacus metus, posuere eget, lacinia
eu, varius quisI keep experimenting with Chicken and Dumpling recipes and this time I’m actually
tweaking one of my own. This time though, I didn’t want to do it on the stove and I wanted to make it
a little less needy, so I’m not tweaking it too much.
When it comes to the slow cooker, I rarely measure out the veggies. Like today, I had a bunch of
carrots and celery in the fridge, so I dumped all the celery in and half of the carrots. After dicing them
of course. If you’re looking for a measurement, I generally do anywhere from 1/2 cup to 2 cups. This
time around, I’m adding greed peppers to the mix, but not too much. I found diced onions and green
peppers in the frozen veggie section at the store and I love using them. I can add a little or a lot – it
doesn’t matter because I’m not having to waste the rest of the veggie. It’s awesome. I always keep
a bag of both in the freeze now because it’s so easy to add that touch of onion/green pepper to any
dish – meatloaf, chicken, soups, etc – it’s all good. So I did add a little diced green pepper, but just
enough to give the stew some flavor mollis vel, tempus placerat, vestibulum condimentum, ligula.
Nunc lacus metus, posuere eget, lacinia eu, varius quisand not becoming over powering. Maybe
about 1/4 cup if that. The onions…my boys love them, so I rarely have to worry about how much !
I ALWAYS measure the spices, so those are generally a good guideline. I’m still tweaking the
amounts, so if you try this and find something that works better, I would love to know about it. I’m
planning on shredding the chicken once it gets closer to dinner time, so cook it whole or dice it –
it’s up to you.
Directions::
Layer the chicken breasts along the bottom of a slow cooker. Layer on top the carrots, onion,
green peppers and celery. Next add all the spices, leaving out the flour. Stir in chicken broth. Cover
and cook on high 3 hours. Stir flour in 1 cup of water until smooth. Stir into slow cooker. Cover and
cook 1 hour or until vegetables are tender and chicken is no longer pink. mollis vel, tempus placerat,
vestibulum condimentum, ligula. Nunc lacus metus, posuere eget, lacinia eu, varius quis For Herb
Dumplings: combine biscuit mix and herbs in small bowl. Stir in milk to form soft dough. Spoon
dumpling mixture on top of stew with a scoop or spoon. Cook, uncovered, 30 minutes. Cover and
cook 30 to 45 minutes or until dumplings are firm and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Serve in shallow bowls.

Chicken Stew and Herb DumplingsIngredients:
2 cups sliced carrots 1 cup chopped onion 1/2 cup sliced celery 1/4 cup or less diced
green peppers 2 cans (14oz each) of chicken broth 2/3 cup all-purpose flour 1 cup water 3
boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in half 1 tsp dried basil leaves 3/4 tsp dried rosemary
1/4 tsp dried tarragon 3/4 to 1 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper
Herb Dumplings: (recipe is doubled already)
• 2 cup biscuit mix
• 1/2 tsp dried basil leaves
• 1/2 tsp dried rosemary
• 1/3 tsp dried tarragon
• 2/3 cup reduced fat (2%) milk
• 1/2 lacinia pretium, pede metus molestie lacus
• 1/2 gravida wisi ante at libero. Quisque ornare
• 1/2 placerat risus. Ut molestie magna at mi.
• 1/2 Integer aliquet mauris et nibh. Ut mattis ligula
